description: Source code for the DisplayInfo plugin implementation, providing system display and connection information via a web interface.

classes.name: DisplayInfo
classes.description: Implements a plugin that provides display and connection information via web requests.

methods.name: DisplayInfo::Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin, setting up connection properties and graphics properties.

methods.name: DisplayInfo::Deinitialize
methods.description: Cleans up resources and releases connection and graphics properties.

methods.name: DisplayInfo::Information
methods.description: Returns plugin information; currently no additional info.

methods.name: DisplayInfo::Inbound

methods.name: DisplayInfo::Process
methods.description: Processes web requests, returning display info in JSON format for GET requests.

methods.name: DisplayInfo::Info
methods.description: Populates display info data structure with current system display and connection properties.
